free_text: The decision to defer biopsy is supported by the cohort criterion, which matched the reading urologist in two cases with a prior positive biopsy and a PI-RADS 2 finding. This is further supported by the retrieved prior biopsy grade of ISUP GG 1 and the PI-RADS 2 finding on the MRI. The rising PSA trajectory is considered consistent with the known disease course, leading to the convergence on deferral.
